scene_hypothesis: A modern, minimalist bedroom with a large bed centered against a gray accent wall, flanked by two nightstands. The room features recessed ceiling lights, a ventilation grille, and two framed artworks above the bed. A window with black blinds is on the left wall. The floor is carpeted in a light beige tone. The visible side of the room includes a partial view of a white wall or column framing the shot.

additions.description: sliding door with frosted glass panel for privacy, leading to an adjacent closet or hallway
additions.reason: To complete the room’s layout by providing access to storage or other areas, typical in bedrooms.
additions.placement_intent: on the left wall, partially obscured by the foreground column, aligned with the window's height range

additions.description: black blackout curtain panels hanging from a rod above the window, matching the window frame color
additions.reason: To provide light control and privacy, complementing the existing black blinds and enhancing the room’s cohesive dark accent theme.
additions.placement_intent: hanging from a rod positioned directly above the window, covering the entire window opening

additions.description: low-profile upholstered chair with dark fabric, placed near the foot of the bed for reading or sitting
additions.reason: To add functional seating near the bed without obstructing the space, common in bedrooms for convenience.
additions.placement_intent: positioned to the right of the bed, facing the headboard, with its back against the gray wall

additions.description: small potted snake plant on the left nightstand, adding a touch of greenery
additions.reason: To introduce natural elements and soften the room’s aesthetic while maintaining the minimalist style.
additions.placement_intent: placed on the left nightstand, next to the lamp, at a height consistent with the table surface
